Kopana : m. (pl.): Name of a Janapada.

Listed by Saṁjaya among the southern Janapadas (also called Deśas 6. 10. 68) of the Bhāratavarṣa (athāpare janapadā dakṣiṇā…) 6. 10. 56, 5; (samaṅgāḥ kopanāś caiva) 6. 10. 59.
